name: Nu Holdings
thesis: Latin America's leading digital bank (Brazil + Mexico + Colombia). Three engines: (1) customer count compounding on network effects + low-CAC acquisition, (2) ARPAC (revenue per active customer) ramping as customers add credit + investment products, (3) operating leverage as cost-to-serve stays near-zero. Bet: 25%+ revenue growth with ROE crossing 30% and durable Brazil profitability funding Mexico/Colombia expansion. STUB regenerated from corrupted source — needs user review.
key_driver: Customer count × ARPAC × NIM with NPL controlled

tier_1_kpis.name: Total customers (millions)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Net adds <5M per quarter for 2 consecutive Qs

tier_1_kpis.name: Monthly ARPAC (USD)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: ARPAC growth <15% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs

tier_1_kpis.name: Net interest margin (NIM)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: NIM compresses >100bps YoY for 2 consecutive Qs

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.

business_model_rules.narrative: 90d+ NPL > 7% for 2Q — credit-quality break; their underwriting thesis depends on the 5-6% historical range holding.
Monthly ARPAC < $10 for 2Q — cross-sell stalling; expanding ARPAC is the unit-economics flywheel.
Activity rate < 82% for 2Q — customers becoming dormant; engagement-flywheel signal.
15-90d NPL > 5% for 2Q — leading indicator of cohort credit deterioration; fires 1-2Q before 90d+ trips.
